basis: Source explicitly parametrizes cuda/mps and skips mps when unavailable. This Linux CUDA host necessarily cannot provide MPS, and the complete suite records exactly one skip. The -q log does not include the skipped node ID.
native_cuda_ad_limitation: Passing supported Torch derivative tests does not establish correlation reverse/forward AD support in the pre-existing Triton bin kernel. Two default-native tests check parity with that existing behavior.
